name: @appstrate/browser-use
description: Browser Use Cloud's hosted MCP server (api.browser-use.com): delegate web tasks to Browser Use's cloud browser agent. `run_session` starts a session on a task, `send_task` sends a follow-up to an idle keep-alive session, and browser profiles reuse persistent website logins. Tasks can run for minutes, so the agent polls `get_session` for status, output and a live URL to watch. Connect with an API key from the Browser Use Cloud dashboard. `run_session` and `send_task` consume Browser Use credits.

api_key.title: Clé d'API
api_key.description: Clé créée dans le tableau de bord Browser Use Cloud (https://cloud.browser-use.com → API Keys). Les tâches lancées avec cette clé consomment les crédits du projet auquel elle appartient.
